newsitem.title: USA: USA Waste reports loss in third quarter.
newsitem.headline: USA Waste reports loss in third quarter.

text.p: USA Waste, the nation's third-largest solid waste company, Tuesday reported a third-quarter loss after a one-time charge of $50.8 million to abandon or dispose of noncore assets.

The Houston-based company had a loss of $38.9 million, or 27 cents a share, in the quarter ended Sept. 30, compared with profits of $24.7 million, or 22 cents a share, in the year-ago period. Operating revenues rose to $352.8 million from $262.4 million.
USA Waste completed the acquisition of Sanifill Inc. for $1.6 billion, catapulting it to the top ranks in the industry.
USA Waste serves municipal, commercial, industrial and residential customers in 35 states, Washington DC, Canada, Puerto Rico and Mexico.
Its stock rose 62.5 cents to $33.125 on the New York Stock Exchange.
